title: Knowledge
subtitle: Turn saved documents, web pages, and slides into reviewed, source-linked knowledge.
purposeHint: Audience, intended use, and anything to focus on.
savedOnly: Uses saved versions. Draft edits are excluded.
automaticHint: Independently review generated drafts and save those that pass. Anything uncertain stays for your review.
manualHint: Drafts wait for your review before they are saved.
scopeHint: This preference applies to your knowledge tasks in this space.
question: Your answer
sourceChanged: The source has changed. Create a new task to use its current version.
editHint: Editing switches this draft to manual review.
approved: Saved to files and project history.
conflict: This task or review preference changed. Refresh to see its current state.
invalidInput: Check the selected sources and your input.
selectTask: Select a task to see its progress and draft.
readOnly: Keep source facts, inference and user input distinct when reviewing.
pending: A submission is pending. Retry with the same selection to avoid creating duplicates.
targetChanged: Saved knowledge changed, or this task needs a fresh comparison. Start a new task to review the current version.
recordHint: Reviewed knowledge with its original sources and saved versions.
recordChanged: This knowledge no longer matches its current sources. Open the sources or create a new knowledge task.
recordUnavailable: This knowledge is unavailable or you no longer have access.
resultKind: Knowledge · {count, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}}
previousHint: This update includes human-reviewed content. The saved version stays unchanged until you review and approve its replacement.
previousConfirm: I reviewed the saved content and approve replacing this version.
previousFailed: Could not load the saved version.
contextLimit: The saved sources and prior knowledge exceed this task’s context limit. Split the sources or reduce the prior knowledge, then try again. Saved files have not changed.
rulesHint: Choose which saved content creates knowledge drafts when it changes. Automatic review is a separate setting.
rulesEnabledHint: This rule applies only to your work in this space. It starts after you apply it.
rulesAll: All saved documents in this project or personal space
rulesExclusionsWin: Exclusions always win. Excluding one document keeps its descendants eligible; excluding a subtree removes all its descendants.
rulesSelectionSummary: {documents, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}}, {subtrees, plural, one {# subtree} other {# subtrees}}; {exclusions, plural, one {# exclusion} other {# exclusions}}.
rulesPage: Showing {shown, number} of {total, number} saved documents. Selections on other pages are preserved.
rulesSourcesChanged: Saved sources changed. Reload the source list; your selections will be kept.
rulesBackfillHint: Leave this off to process only new or changed sources after this rule is applied. Applying a replacement rule resets this baseline.
rulesPreviewResult: {count, plural, one {# saved source matches} other {# saved sources match}}. Preview did not create tasks.
rulesPreviewHint: Preview the scope after changing this rule, then apply it.
rulesPauseHint: Turning this off cancels automatic work that has not been adopted or started saving. Manual work and saved knowledge are kept.
rulesReloadHint: Reloading replaces your unsaved rule edits.
rulesSaveUnknown: The rule may have changed. Reload the saved rule before applying more changes.
rulesUsage: Drafts created today: {used, number}. Unfinished: {pending, number}.
rulesQueue: Waiting: {queued, number}. Preparing: {claimed, number}. Could not queue: {failed, number}.
rulesSourceUnavailable: Saved sources cannot be checked. New automatic work is on hold.
rulesBudget: The scope or task budget has been reached. Reduce the scope or wait for the next budget period.
rulesEngineRequired: Configure a knowledge model before enabling automatic generation. You can still edit or pause a rule.
rulesSharedBudget: Across your projects: {used, number}/{daily, number} drafts today; {pending, number}/{pendingLimit, number} unfinished.
rulesInstallationBudget: This installation allows up to {daily, number} new automatic drafts per day and {pending, number} unfinished automatic drafts across all users.
rulesBudgetHold: New automatic work is waiting for shared capacity or the next UTC day. Changing projects or rules does not reset usage.
finishTaskAction: Save the draft or wait for the current action before changing pages.
sourceSelected: {count, plural, one {# selected source} other {# selected sources}}
sourcePage: {start, number}–{end, number} of {total, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}}
sourceUnavailable: Could not load saved content. Reload sources to try again.
rulesOriginalsEnabled: Include saved web pages or slides
rulesOriginalsHint: These sources are selected separately from document trees. Only the types you choose are eligible; exclusions take precedence.
rulesOriginalsAll: Include all saved originals of the selected types
rulesOriginalsChooseTypes: Select at least one content type to browse originals.
rulesOriginalsSummary: Individual rules: {included, number} included; {excluded, number} excluded.
